product.description: These all-purpose shears from KitchenAid are a valuable addition to your kitchen utensils set and ideal for a variety of tasks throughout the home, from slicing poultry and pizza to clipping coupons. The blade edges feature micro-serrations to provide a superior cutting experience. Durable and strong, these kitchen scissors are made from heavy-duty stainless steel that withstands daily use, with soft-grip handles that provide comfort and control while using. The shears come with a blade guard to protect blades when stored. Dishwasher safe; hand washing is recommended.

top_reviews.title: Sharp, comfortable, and reliable kitchen shears
top_reviews.body: I’ve been using these KitchenAid all-purpose kitchen shears regularly, and they’ve been very reliable for everyday kitchen tasks.The stainless steel blades are sharp and cut cleanly through herbs, vegetables, meat packaging, and even thicker materials without slipping. The micro-serrated edges really help keep food in place, which makes cutting feel controlled and effortless.The soft grip handle is comfortable to hold, even during longer prep sessions. It provides a secure, non-slip grip and helps reduce hand fatigue, which I appreciate when doing a lot of cutting at once.I also like that the shears come with a protective sheath. It keeps the blades safe when stored in a drawer and adds an extra layer of safety.Overall, these are well-made, durable kitchen shears that perform consistently and feel comfortable to use. A solid addition to any kitchen.
